prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Create ONE square nine-panel illustrated service-manual plate for a motorized Smith exercise machine. A mathematically regular 3 by 3 contact sheet of nine equally sized square cells, read across each row. All nine drawings independent fully contained in their cells with generous empty margin around each; identical clean warm-white canvas, near-invisible or no dividers. No lettering, no numbers, no captions, no logos. Crisp physical technical illustrations, charcoal steel twin vertical guide columns carrying a horizontal silver bar between rectangular moving carriages, teal blue for left movement, amber for right or change. Orthographic close-ups, restrained product manual style, simple arrows, no background clutter. Mechanically plausible and legible at 140px thumbnail. Do not combine cells. Specific scenes in row-major order:

Fine teal dashed horizontal datum line at both ends aligned with the bar center. A small amber downward arrow above the middle of the bar, and a small amber upward arrow below it suggesting a brief diagnostic force while holding a position. Crisp physical technical illustration, generous margin, clean warm white background, restrained warm grey metallic shading, teal left carriage outline, amber right cue. Clear at a 160px thumbnail.
